title: Artificial is a wicked satire that also sticks to the facts
key_facts: Luca Guadagnino's satirical Sam Altman film Artificial premiered at the New York Film Festival.
Andrew Garfield plays Altman; Yura Borisov plays Ilya Sutskever; Ike Barinholtz plays Elon Musk.
The Verge says the film sticks closely to real events, including Altman's rise at OpenAI and his brief ouster.
The film is structured in chapters of real milestones, from Sutskever meeting Geoffrey Hinton to a 2017 OpenAI Dota 2 win.
The characters are exaggerated; some scenes, such as a bunker under Altman's home, are invented.
The reviewer calls Garfield's portrayal the most damning picture of Altman in any media yet.
Amazon MGM Studios dropped the film in June after Amazon's $50 billion OpenAI investment; limited release is 25 Dec 2026.
quote_evidence: At the New York Film Festival premiere of Artificial, Luca Guadagnino’s satirical Sam Altman biopic, the director said onstage that “[when] someone wants to play God, that’s very interesting to me.”
Artificial will be out in limited release on December 25, 2026.
why_it_matters_hint: A major film dramatises the OpenAI story and its power struggle.
event_date: NYFF premiere; exact date not stated (Verge published 8 Oct 2026).
notes: A review: opinions are the reviewer's. No response from Altman or OpenAI appears in the article.
